LOST & FOUND ARTICLES
User Manual for
Delhi Police Lost Report
01/02/2016

INTRODUCTION
SUMMARY
Almost everyone has lost an important document; be it a driving licence, passport, particulars of one’s
property or academic records. Once lost, the person who has lost his/her important document end-up
wasting considerable time and energy in locating the correct police station, filling a complaint and
answering lengthy and sometimes irrelevant questions from a suspicious police official, one would finally
obtain a copy of the police report to initiate the process of re-issuing of duplicates.
In an attempt to ease the Public (domicile or Visitors)’s misery and make the process quick and hassle
free. Delhi Police launched its first e –Governance module, the Lost Report App on 27 February,
2014. Any Person can now report the loss of anything, including any document, to Delhi Police using this
App from their mobile phone or computer from anywhere in the world and obtain a digitally signed police
report instantly on his email, without the hassle of visiting a police. This report can be used to apply for
re-issue of any lost document and the issuing department can even verify the police report through the
App itself.
The idea for the mobile application was conceived by Delhi Police Commissioner Shri Bhim Sain Bassi. It
was developed under the supervision of Senior Special Commissioner of Police (Special Unit) Shri
Dharmendra Kumar, DCP Shri Rajan Bhagat and ADCP Mahesh Batra.
(ii) Problems identified,
Following were the identified problems:
• Large volume of complaints being lodged at a police station.
• The process of filing the NC-FIR was manual; hence the person needs to first of all identify and
travel to the nearest Police station.
• A complainant needed to visit the same police station where the article was lost and wait for the
availability of the concerned person to file a complaint.
• persons travelling through Delhi or tourists rarely find it possible to go back to the place where the
article or document could have been lost and lodge a report in the closest police station

• The loss of such items is usually reported after some delay after the actual incident, and details
shared by the complainant are sketchy and not necessarily accurate.
• It was very difficult for police officials to keep a record of all the filed NC-FIRs for lost articles over
the years manually in the physical files. The pile of hand-written data was neither manageable nor
protected from even very common issues like pests.
• All these problems made Delhi police officials realize the need of a fundamental shift in the basic
process so that Public (domicile or Visitors)s can be provided with world class services more
efficiently.
• Also police officials needed to automate this manual process so that they could more efficiently on
the investigation and tracking part which needed more attention.
(iii) Roll out/implementation model,
The Lost Report application was developed within three months time, both for web-based as well as for
mobile version. The application development was commenced under the overall supervision of Sr. Special
CP (Special Unit), Sh. Dharmendra Kumar.
The project implementation work was started under the leadership of Sh. Rajan Bhagat, DCP (CRO) for
web-based version and Sh. Mahesh Batra, Addl. DCP (IT) for mobile version. The application
developement was done in-house with outsource software development team stationed at PHQ.
PURPOSE
Delhi Police department receives the complaints of lost items, in excess of six lakhs per year, especially
critical items such as mobile phones, passports, identity cards and so on. Since the lost items tend not to
be treated as urgent requests, but must be reported as part of the system and the existing processes,
considerable time in the filing and processing of the paperwork involved in the manual entry of these
complaints.

Moreover, lodging a police report about a lost document becomes unavoidable where there is a
prerequisite for reissue of a lost document such as a Passport, the loss of such items is usually reported
after some delay after the actual incident, and details shared by the complainant are vague and not
necessarily accurate, in particular, persons travelling through Delhi or tourists rarely find it possible to go
back to the place where the article or document could have been lost and lodge a report in the closest
police station.
The Lost Report application is dedicated completely to Public (domicile or Visitors)s of Delhi where life of
Public (domicile or Visitors)s have been tried to make easier by letting them lodge lost article complaints
online instead of visiting the police station multiple times.
The application removes the geographical and time barriers for assessing the services by Public (domicile
or Visitors).
A Public (domicile or Visitors) who wants to lodge a complaint for their lost article can download the Delhi
police mobile application online free of cost from Google play, i OS and Windows store and easily file
complaint after following some simple registration steps.
On submission, a digitally signed report will be instantaneously sent back to the complainant's email id
and phone number.
This report is valid everywhere as a proof of lost article and can be used to apply for duplicate document.
Since most of these lost articles like Pan Card, Voter ID Card etc. can be re-issued by submitting the
Police Report, complainants mostly just need to get their complaints registered promptly so that they can
easily apply for the re-issuing of the lost documents. Hence, this is the really useful for the Public
(domicile or Visitors).
Also this lost report bears a unique lost report number (LR number) about the lodged report which can be
used to access or retrieve the report in future.
This whole application truly eliminates the cumbersome and tiring process of visiting police station just to
get a lost report.
Also the police force also get freed up from manual incommodious process of writing down NC-FIRs and
get more time to concentrate on their on-field job.

WHAT YOU NEED TO REPORT LOST ARTICLE:
For lodging a lost article report your need a computer with internet connection.
HOW TO APPLY FOR “LOST & FOUND ARTICLE REPORT”
1. Visit Delhi Police official website www.delhipolice.nic.in
2. Click on ‘Lost & Found’ icon.

3. Now click on ‘Lost Article Report’ or ‘Found Article Report’ and you will see following options:
‘Lost Article Report’
a) Retrieve : For downloading an already registered lost article report.
b) Register (LOST) : For registering fresh lost article report.
c) Search Found Articles : To check if any article for which you have registered a lost report, is found or not.
d) FAQ : Frequently Asked Questions.
‘Found Article Report’
a) Register (FOUND) : To submit the information about any article which is found by public.
b) FAQ : Frequently Asked Questions.

LOST ARTICLE REPORT
REGISTER
1. For registering a fresh lost article report, click on ‘Register’

3. After submitting the report you will see message ‘Record Saved successfully’ and a copy of your lost report will be downloaded
automatically on your computer in PDF format. Another copy will also be sent on the email you have used which report
registration.

RETREIVE
1. To download a copy of an already registered lost article report click on ‘Retrieve’. Put the required details and click on ‘Search’
button.

2. Now click on ‘View Reports’ button to download the lost article report

SEARCH FOUND ARTICLES
1. To search whether your article is been found or not, put your LR number and email id you have used for submitting lost report.

FOUND ARTICLE REPORT
REGISTER
1. To submit the information about the article your have found, click on the ‘Register’ button.

2. Type your mobile number and click on ‘Send’ button.

3. Now type the OTP received in your mobile phone and click ‘Verify’ button.

4. Now select found article category and type article identification number and click on ‘Search’ button.
5. If article not found in the Delhi Police database add the article by uploading photo and description of the found article and click
‘Submit’ button. The record will be added in central database and shall be available for search in the application.

Document Information
This chapter gives a brief introduction to the objective, scope and benefits of creating this Manual.
1.1 Purpose of this document
Delhi Police has consistently been adopting new methodologies and technologies to enhance its services
deliveries and capacity. Our endeavor has been to identify areas where state of art knows how we can
help in reducing public inconvenience.
Delhi Police has taken the historic step to enable mobile and web based application to lodge First
Information Report of Motor Vehicle Theft in Delhi.
The process includes digital modules to investigate and generate untraced report against the FIR.
1.2 Objective
The main objective includes:
 Immediate lodging / downloading of First Information Report (FIR) for Vehicles Stolen in Delhi
through
o Mobile
o Web
o Police Station
 Online investigation including electronic checking of vehicles
 Final Report u/s 173 CrPC sent to eCourt on 21st day for getting claim from Insurance
Company.
1.3 Benefits of Motor Vehicle Theft application:
The various benefits of application are:
 No need to visit Police Station to Lodge FIR
 Hassle free and Immediate registration of FIR
 No problem in getting a copy of FIR
 No chasing of IO to get “Untraced Report”
 Early Insurance Claim
 A lot of time of the complainants, IOs, SHOs, senior officers and Courts saved
 A lot of paper will be saved due to electronic storage of records
 Timely filling of FIR, Case Diaries, Untraced Report at Police Station level

 Functional aspects include uploading and downloading of documents.
 User can add, edit, and view information.

Public Module
Any citizen can login to the application through registered email id & mobile number. Once the login is
authenticated through the system, the user can register FIR, retrieve FIR, and can view the status of case
as well.
2.1 Login the Application
The login page allows user to enter his login credentials for accessing the Application. There may be two
types of users who want to access this Application, one a new user and the other one existing user.
Therefore user could be new or the existing one.
2.1.1 New User
The steps for new user to login the application are:
1. Browse the Delhi Police Website: www.delhipolice.nic.in
2. Click on ‘Motor Vehicle Theft’ Link. The page displays as shown below:
3. Click on New User tile, the page displays as shown below:

4. User will enter the user name, email id, and mobile number to register.
5. Click on ‘Sign Up’ button to get the ‘Validate OTP’ screen as shown below:
Note: A one-time password (OTP) is a password which is valid for only one login session transaction for
two hours. There are two buttons ‘Verify’ and ‘New OTP’ in Validate OTP screen. User needs to enter
the 4 digit OTP received in his mobile number or email id.
6. Enter the 4 digit OTP and then press the Verify button.
7. In case if user don’t get the ‘OTP’ in his mobile then he needs to click on ‘New OTP’ button to
receive the ‘OTP’ in his mobile.

8. After successful verification of OTP, the main screen displays options such as Register FIR,
Retrieve FIR, Retrieve Final Order, FIR Status and FAQs.

mobile number or email ID

7. After successful verification of OTP, the main screen displays options such as Register FIR, Retrieve

Complainant whose vehicle has been stolen in Delhi will click on the ‘Register FIR’ tile
1.On the Main screen, click on the ‘Register FIR’ tile.
First of all, the applicant will be prompted the following question:
2. Click on the ‘Yes’ button which allows the complainant to fill the registration details such as
Complainant details, Vehicle details, Property details, and other details.
3. Enter the complainant details such as name, parentage, gender, country, date of birth, address,

5. Enter the property stolen with vehicle details such as details of property and estimated value.

7. After filling all the details, click on ‘Register FIR’ button then preview page of FIR is shown to

Station House Officer

5.3 Probable Search
This system daily searches all the stolen vehicles which are lodge in e-PS MV theft application with all
unclaimed vehicles in ZIPNET database and write an e-Case diary of the same and report it to “IO” on
daily basis.
The searching parameters to search stolen vehicles in ZIPNET database are:-
 Type of Vehicle
 Engine Number

61
 Chassis Number
If any one of the parameters is matched with the stolen vehicles which are lodged in e-PS MV Theft
application then one alert message is sent by the application to the concerned SHO.
This SMS is subject to physical verification of the unclaimed vehicle with respect to stolen vehicle.
If alert message is sent to SHO then he/she will instruct to “IO” to investigate the same.
After investigation “IO” will open the page of probable search and then click on ‘FIR’ to check the details
given for the same FIR. Thereafter exact match is found then “IO” will click on Yes and transfer the case
to Local Police station else if no match is found then click on No.

9.1 Frequently Asked Questions
Question 01: Why this application has been developed?
Answer: Delhi Police has taken this path breaking initiative to ensure trouble free registration of
e-FIR of Motor Vehicle Thefts in e-Police Station of Delhi, Automated Investigation,
Electronic Generation and Transmission of Final Report for Online Acceptance by the
competent e-Court. The application delivers printable digitally signed Untraced Report
on given mobile and e-mail of complainant to claim insurance.
OBJECTIVE
1.) Facilitating IO for systematic investigation on e-platform
2.) Proper Documentation
3.) Ease of Investigation
4.) Effective supervision
5.) Easy for public to register an FIR
6.) Better communication directly with the Court
7.) Effective monitoring and disposal of cases
Public Module
1.) Registration of FIR through mobile or web from anywhere by the public as well as
police for the theft cases
2.) FIR as per verbatim and truthful registration of crime
3.) Availability of this facility to register FIR on web from Police Station
4.) Online communication with the complainant to interact with Investigation officer
Question 02: What is the procedure of lodging a Motor Vehicle Theft FIR?
Answer: Public can lodge his/her Motor Vehicle Theft FIR in following ways :
1.) If the FIR is being lodged using mobile app, then it is necessary to download and install
mobile Application "Delhi Police Motor Vehicle Theft FIR" from any Android, iOS and
Windows Phone 8 mobile phones.
2.) If FIR is to be lodged using web browser then please visit http://www.delhipolice.nic.in
3.) Public can also visit the police station to lodge MV Theft FIR.
Question 03: What happen after I submit my information?
Answer: A digitally signed "FIR for Motor Vehicle Theft" will be instantly sent back on the mobile
phone and email provided.

95
Question 04: What is the significance of FIR No?
Answer: The Delhi Police Motor Vehicle Theft FIR App’ bears a unique FIR No of information
lodged for search and retrieval in future.
Question 05: What types of complaints can be lodged?
Answer: This service can be used to lodging First Information Report for the Motor Vehicle stolen
in Delhi.
Question 06: What types of complaints cannot be lodged?
Answer: This is not an emergency response service and should not be used to contact the police
if a crime is taking place or is in progress or there is imminent danger to someone’s life
or property.
In above situations or in emergency: Always call 100 or contact nearest police station
Question 07: I have not received an e-mail confirmation even though I have submitted my report.
Answer: You may have accidentally provided a wrong e-mail address or your e-mail inbox is full.˙
You may also contact the SCRB, Delhi Police, Delhi at 011-23237006 to check your
report.
Question 08: I am a foreigner. Can I lodge a ‘Motor Vehicle Theft FIR’ online?
Answer: You can lodge FIR through this application, if your vehicle is stolen from Delhi.
Question 09: Is any investigation/enquiry done by police after lodging of a complaint?
Answer: An inquiry will be done by police.
Question 10: What action will be taken if complainant lodged any false report?
Answer: False complaint/information to the police is a punishable offence.
Question 11: Whether the print out of report taken is to be submitted in any police station?
Answer: No
Question 12: Whether “Motor Vehicle Theft FIR” can be lodged if vehicle is stolen outside the area
of Delhi?
Answer: No.
Question 13: Whether “Motor Vehicle Theft FIR” can be retrieved or not?
Answer: Yes, through retrieve button on main page.
Question 14: Which Android OS version is compatible with Android Mobile App?
Answer: Android 4.0 and above.
iPhone 5.0 and above.
Windows 8 and above.

96
Question 15: Is a DATA connection mandatory?
Answer: Yes.
Question 16: What are the charges for downloading and using Delhi Police App?
Answer: Delhi Police offers Mobile Application FREE of charge to the public. . You can download
and use this application as and when needed without any charge.
Your mobile operator will levy charges for GPRS/ 3G. Please check with your operator
for details.
Question 17: How to Login into the application?
Answer: You have to take following steps to login in to app :
1.) Download the " Delhi Police Motor Vehicle Theft FIR " application on your device or
Open the URL on your browser.
2.) If you are a new user register, on the application by giving name, Mobile number and
E-mail ID and press submit button.
3.) If you are a exiting user, provide your registered mobile no or email id to login.
4.) You will get an OTP for Verification.
5.) Once OTP will be verified, you will get logged in to app
Question 18: How I can get a copy of my FIR of MV Theft?
Answer: You have to take the following steps to get a soft copy of your FIR Copy:
1.) Login into application
2.) Click on retrieve button.
3.) Then select the FIR No. you want to download.
4.) The copy of FIR will appear on the screen and a copy of FIR will be mailed
simultaneously to complainant email Id.
Question 19: How I can report loss of more than one item along with stolen vehicle?
Answer: You have to click on the (+) button in front of the first stolen article to add additional

Question 20: What to do when date and time of vehicle theft is not known?
Answer: On many occasions, the exact date and time of vehicle theft is not known. In this case,
the period starting from a particular date and time and ending on a date and time
during which the vehicle was stolen can be entered.
Question 21: How to choose Police Station for place of theft for Motor Vehicle?
Answer: The complainant needs to enter the place of theft. The app will automatically choose
the area police station and its district. The complainant has the option to edit the place
of theft (occurrence) at the time of entering personal details.

Question 22: How to validate the signature appearing on FIR Copy?
Answer: To validate the digital signature appearing on Copy of FIR is as follow:
1.) Open Copy of FIR on Adobe Acrobat pdf reader.
2.) Click on ‘?’ on signature appearing in yellow colour.
3.) On Prompt Signature Validation Status Click on Signature Properties Button.
4.) Click on Button Show Certificate in Summary tab.
5.) After it click on Trust tab.
6.) Inside Trust tab click on button Add to trust Identities.
7.) Click on OK.
8.) Again click on OK.
9.) Again click on OK.
10.) Then click on Validate Signature button.
11.) At last click on close button.
